backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no logic.
feature_evidence.json: JSON report stub containing an empty features list.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file holding prewritten summaries of various frontend source files.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind setup defining theme variables, dark mode overrides, and global background/text styling.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React component managing interface state transitions, click heart particles, and music provider.
frontend/src/components/effects/ClickHea: Renders temporary heart icons at click locations with a fade-out animation.
frontend/src/components/effects/Floating: Generates multiple floating heart elements that rise slowly from the bottom.
frontend/src/components/effects/HeartBur: Creates a 30‑particle heart and kiss emoji burst effect originating from screen center.
frontend/src/components/effects/Occasion: Periodically spawns hearts at random positions that float gently before disappearing.
frontend/src/components/memory/MemoryIco: Grid component displaying memory icons that trigger callbacks when clicked.
frontend/src/components/memory/sections/: Sequentially reveals compliment cards with animated entry transitions.
Displays a series of story paragraphs separated by heart dividers.
Lists letters that expand into scrollable vintage-style letter views when opened.
Shows playlist cards with descriptions and external Spotify links.
Renders animated romantic paragraphs imagining a future marriage.
Reveals poetic lines one by one with timed fade-in animations.
Displays the 'Why I'll Never Leave You' memory section using themed styling and text from valentineContent.
frontend/src/components/music/MusicContr: Creates a React context to manage background music playback and exposes play/pause controls via a provider hook.
frontend/src/components/music/MusicToggl: Renders a floating button that toggles background music using icons to show play or pause state.
frontend/src/components/overlays/MemoryO: Shows a modal overlay that loads a specific memory section based on the selected ID and supports closing.
frontend/src/components/sections/Interfa: Displays the initial proposal screen with intro text, a romantic question, and two buttons to proceed.
Shows a celebratory transition screen with animated text and auto-progresses to the next step after a delay.
Renders a memory selection menu grid and opens overlays for detailed sections, with a button to continue.
Shows a final surprise letter revealed after a button press, with floating hearts and styled romantic text.
frontend/src/content/valentineContent.ts: Holds all static Valentine’s UI content, including texts, menu items, letters, playlists, and section data.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor instance tied to the user’s identity, refreshing dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context, loading stored identities and exposing login/clear utilities.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers plus extensive CSS variables for light/dark themes and romantic color utilities, along with custom background and typography utility classes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with ReactDOM, wraps it in React Query and Internet Identity providers, and loads global styles.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with dark mode, content paths, extended theming using CSS variables, custom fonts, colors, and animations, plus plugins.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata, feature inventory, and pending feature requests for the ICP-based Valentine-themed app.
